The '''Damarind Fishing Station''' was a large [[Space station/Legends|space station]] built by the [[Damarind Corporation]] in an orbit that lay midway between the [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] and its [[Yavin 1|first]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The Damarind station served as a fishing port for the company fleet. Its role was to collect [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca stones]] that the gas giant produced naturally. However, the station failed to harvest enough gems to keep Damarind Corporation solvent, and the conglomerate went bankrupt eventually.<ref name="GG2" />
